sceptic: **We built Lolly for ourselves.** SUSE needed thousands of on-brand files, each with its name sealed inside, made without handing anything to outside services. So we built a tool that does all of it on the device, and released it as open source, like everything else we make. We keep maintaining it because we use it every day. **There is no obligation:** everything here works with or without us.
